scenario.title: 聽懂開玩笑、反諷，正確回答否定問句
scenario.context: 「你不是要去嗎？」「對，我不去。」——中文和英文回答否定問句的邏輯剛好相反，這是台灣人最常答反的地方。這個單元也教你聽懂英文的反諷和玩笑，避免把 Yeah, right 當真。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Aren't you coming to the team dinner?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: No, I'm not. I have a deadline.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Karen said the boss is paying, and he's ordering lobster.
lines.zh: Karen 說老闆請客，還要點龍蝦。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yeah, right. He wouldn't even pay for coffee last month.
lines.zh: 最好是啦。上個月他連咖啡都不請。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Ha, JK. It's split the bill as usual.
lines.zh: 哈，開玩笑的，照例各付各的。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Didn't you prepare a speech for Leo's birthday?
lines.zh: 你沒有為 Leo 的生日準備致詞嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yes, I did! It's more of a roast, though.
lines.zh: 有，我有準備！不過比較像是吐槽大會。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Isn't he sensitive about his cooking?
lines.zh: 他不是對自己的廚藝很敏感嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: No, he's not. He jokes about it himself. He once set off the fire alarm making toast.
lines.zh: 不，他不會。他自己也拿來開玩笑，他曾經烤吐司烤到火災警報響。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.zh: 喔，太好了。幹得好啊 Leo。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I'll keep it friendly. A good roast should make him laugh too.
lines.zh: 我會保持友善。好的吐槽應該也要讓他笑。

patterns.note: 常是反諷，意思是「一點都不好笑」

chinglish.wrong: A: Aren't you coming? B: Yes, I'm not coming.
chinglish.right: B: No, I'm not. / Right, I'm not coming.
chinglish.why: 英文回答否定問句只看事實：不去就說 No。中文習慣先附和問題（對，我不去），直翻成 Yes 會讓對方以為你要去。

chinglish.wrong: A: Don't you like it? B: No, I like it.
chinglish.right: B: Yes, I do! I love it.
chinglish.why: 喜歡就說 Yes，不管問題是肯定還是否定。

chinglish.right: I'm joking. / I'm kidding. / I'm messing with you.
chinglish.why: joke 通常不直接接人，說 joke with / kid / mess with someone。

chinglish.wrong: You are very funny.（其實想說對方講的話很荒謬）
chinglish.why: 英文反諷靠語調。Very funny 用平淡或翻白眼的語氣，意思是「一點都不好笑」。

grammar.title: 否定疑問句的 Yes / No
grammar.oneLiner: 不管問句是肯定還是否定，英文的 Yes / No 只看事實：事實是肯定就說 Yes，事實是否定就說 No。
whenToUse: 否定疑問句：Aren't you…? / Don't you…? / Didn't you…? / Isn't it…?
功能：表示驚訝、確認自己的預期、或委婉提議。Isn't that your phone?
要去：Yes, I am. / 不去：No, I'm not.
喜歡：Yes, I do. / 不喜歡：No, I don't.
避免混亂的方法：Yes / No 後面一定加完整短句（Yes, I am / No, I'm not）。
也可以用 Right / Actually 開頭：Right, I'm not going. / Actually, I am.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文回答問題是「同意或不同意對方的說法」：「你不去嗎？」「對（你說得對），我不去。」英文則是「回答事實本身」：不去就是 No。所以台灣人常回 Yes, I'm not going，對方完全混亂。這是母語者一聽就發現、但台灣人自己很難察覺的錯誤。

examples.correct: A: Aren't you hungry? B: No, I'm not. I just ate.
A: Didn't you get my email? B: Yes, I did. Sorry for the late reply.
A: Don't you want to come? B: Actually, I do!
examples.note: 用 Actually 表示「其實我想」。

examples.correct: Isn't this the café we went to last year?
A: You don't eat meat, right? B: Right, I don't.
examples.note: 用 Right 附和也可以避免混淆。

quiz.question: A: Aren't you tired? B: (你不累) ___
quiz.explanation: 事實是不累，說 No, I'm not。

quiz.question: A: Don't you like spicy food? B: (你喜歡) ___
quiz.explanation: 事實是喜歡，說 Yes, I do。

quiz.question: A: Didn't you lock the door? B: (你沒鎖) ___
quiz.explanation: 事實是沒鎖，說 No, I didn't。

quiz.question: A: Isn't it your birthday today? B: ___, it is! (是)
Your friend says "Yeah, right" in a flat voice after you say you'll wake up at 5 a.m. They mean:

slang.usage: You're pulling my leg! = 你在唬我吧！

examples.en: You won the lottery? You're pulling my leg!
Relax, I'm just pulling your leg.

slang.usage: 訊息中常見，口語也會直接唸 J-K。

risk.note: 用在傷人的話後面，不會讓那句話變得不傷人。

examples.en: I'm quitting tomorrow. JK, I love this job.
examples.zh: 我明天要辭職。開玩笑的，我很愛這份工作。

examples.en: Your haircut is interesting… jk, it looks great!
examples.zh: 你的髮型很特別……開玩笑的，很好看！

slang.usage: 兩個肯定詞組合起來表示「不相信」，靠語調傳達。

risk.note: 對主管或客戶用會顯得不尊重。

examples.en: A: I'll finish it tonight. B: Yeah, right.
examples.zh: A：我今晚會做完。 B：最好是啦。

examples.en: "This will only take five minutes." Yeah, right.

slang.meaning: 吐槽、嘲弄（通常是善意的）
slang.usage: 動詞 roast someone；名詞 a roast（吐槽大會）。

risk.note: 要跟對方夠熟、確定對方開得起玩笑。不熟的人被 roast 會覺得被冒犯。

examples.en: My friends roasted me about my terrible cooking.
examples.zh: 我朋友吐槽我的爛廚藝。

examples.en: We're doing a roast for Leo's 30th.
examples.zh: 我們要幫 Leo 的 30 歲生日辦吐槽大會。

review.question: The joke was ___ hilarious.
review.explanation: 複習第 74 單元：極端形容詞用 absolutely。

review.question: How about ___ (tell) a joke to break the ice?
review.explanation: 複習第 73 單元：How about + V-ing。

review.question: I remember ___ at his joke for ten minutes.
review.explanation: 複習第 71 單元：記得過去做過用 V-ing。

review.question: I heard someone ___ in the next room.
___ I love about him is his sense of humor.
review.explanation: 複習第 59 單元：What 子句。

review.question: He doesn't ___ to be joking. He looks serious.
review.explanation: 複習第 43 單元：doesn't seem to。

review.question: ___ a funny video going around the office.
A: Didn't you see my message? B: (你沒看到) ___
review.explanation: 沒看到就說 No, I didn't。
